[package]
name = "claude-cli"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
authors = ["Claude Bridge Team"]
description = "Universal Claude API client — Rust CLI for prompt caching, vision, tool use, batch processing, and model benchmarking"
license = "MIT"

[[bin]]
name = "claude"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
# CLI
clap = { version = "4.4", features = ["derive"] }
clap-verbosity-flag = "2.1"

# HTTP & JSON
reqwest = { version = "0.11", features = ["json"] }
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }

# Web Server
axum = { version = "0.7", features = ["json"] }
tower = "0.4"
tower-http = { version = "0.5", features = ["cors", "trace"] }
tokio-stream = "0.1"

# Config
toml = "0.8"

# OAuth
oauth2 = "4.4"
jsonwebtoken = "9.3"

# Browser
open = "5.0"

# Logging
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter", "json"] }

# Utilities
anyhow = "1.0"
thiserror = "1.0"
dotenv = "0.15"
colored = "2.0"
prettytable-rs = "0.10"
uuid = { version = "1.0", features = ["v4"] }

# Async
futures = "0.3"

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3.8"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1
strip = true

use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ChatCompletionMessage {
    pub role: String,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub content: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ChatCompletionRequest {
    pub model: String,
    pub messages: Vec<ChatCompletionMessage>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub max_tokens: Option<u32>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub max_completion_tokens: Option<u32>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub temperature: Option<f32>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub top_p: Option<f32>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub stream: Option<bool>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub stop: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub presence_penalty: Option<f32>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub frequency_penalty: Option<f32>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub user: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct ChatCompletionChoice {
    pub index: u32,
    pub message: ChatCompletionMessage,
    pub finish_reason: String,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub logprobs: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct ChatCompletionUsage {
    pub prompt_tokens: u32,
    pub completion_tokens: u32,
    pub total_tokens: u32,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub prompt_tokens_details: Option<serde_json::Value>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub completion_tokens_details: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct ChatCompletionResponse {
    pub id: String,
    pub object: String,
    pub created: u64,
    pub model: String,
    pub choices: Vec<ChatCompletionChoice>,
    pub usage: ChatCompletionUsage,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub system_fingerprint: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct ModelInfo {
    pub id: String,
    pub object: String,
    pub created: u64,
    pub owned_by: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct ModelsResponse {
    pub object: String,
    pub data: Vec<ModelInfo>,
}

// Chunk für Streaming Responses (SSE)
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct ChatCompletionChunk {
    pub id: String,
    pub object: String,
    pub created: u64,
    pub model: String,
    pub choices: Vec<ChunkChoice>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub usage: Option<ChatCompletionUsage>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct ChunkChoice {
    pub index: u32,
    pub delta: Delta,
    pub finish_reason: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug)]
pub struct Delta {
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub role: Option<String>,
    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
    pub content: Option<String>,
}

# claude-cli

**⚠️ WORK IN PROGRESS**

OpenAI-compatible proxy for Claude API in Rust. Translates OpenAI requests to Claude, proxies responses back.

**Current Status:**
- ✅ OpenAI ↔ Claude request/response transform
- ✅ HTTP server skeleton (`claude serve --port 8000`)
- ⚠️ Stub implementation: returns mock response (no real Claude calls yet)
- ❌ Streaming not implemented
- ❌ Tool calling transform incomplete
- ❌ System prompts partially handled

**Legacy CLI features** (pre-refactor, may or may not work):
- Message sending, vision, benchmarking, batch processing (untested after refactor)

## Installation

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/yourusername/claude-cli.git
```

Or build from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yourusername/claude-cli.git
cd claude-cli
cargo build --release
./target/release/claude --help
```

## Configuration

Set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable:

```bash
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-..."
```

Optional configuration via environment variables:

```bash
export ANTHROPIC_API_URL="https://api.anthropic.com/v1"      # Default
export ANTHROPIC_API_VERSION="2023-06-01"                     # Default
export ANTHROPIC_TIMEOUT=30                                    # Seconds
export ANTHROPIC_MAX_RETRIES=3
```

## Quick Start

### Start OpenAI-Compatible Server

```bash
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-..."
claude serve --port 8000
```

Then proxy OpenAI requests:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/messages \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-4o",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
    "max_completion_tokens": 100
  }'
```

**Model mapping:** `gpt-4o` → `claude-opus-4-6`, `gpt-4o-mini` → `claude-haiku-4-5`, etc.

---

## Legacy CLI Commands

(Status: Not recently tested after refactor. May require fixes.)

### Send a Message

```bash
# Simple message
claude message "What is memory consolidation?"

# With system prompt
claude message "Explain X" --system "You are an expert in neuroscience"

# With specific model
claude message "Explain X" --model claude-haiku-4-5

# Enable prompt caching
claude message "Explain X" --cache

# Output formats: text, json, tokens
claude message "Explain X" --format json
```

### Vision API

```bash
claude vision https://example.com/image.png
claude vision https://example.com/graph.png --prompt "Analyze this graph"
```

### Benchmark Models

```bash
# Compare three models on same prompt
claude benchmark "Explain memory consolidation" \
  --models "claude-haiku-4-5,claude-sonnet-4-6,claude-opus-4-6" \
  --format table

# Run multiple iterations
claude benchmark "Test prompt" --iterations 5 --format csv
```

### Batch Processing

```bash
# Submit batch (input.jsonl format: one MessageRequest per line)
claude batch input.jsonl

# Check status
claude batch --status "batch_..."

# Retrieve results
claude batch --result "batch_..."
```

### Tool Use (Function Calling)

```bash
# Request with tools
claude tools '{
  "prompt": "Search for memory consolidation",
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "search",
      "description": "Search function",
      "input_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {...}}
    }
  ]
}'
```

### Token Counting

```bash
# Count tokens in message
claude tokens "Your long message here"

# With system prompt
claude tokens "Message" --system "System prompt"
```

### Cost Calculation

```bash
# Calculate cost for usage
claude cost --input 150 --output 50
claude cost --input 1000 --output 500 --model claude-sonnet-4-6

# Show cache pricing
claude cost --input 100 --output 50 --cache
```

### Configuration

```bash
# Show current configuration
claude config

# Show full API key (masked by default)
claude config --show-key
```

## Examples

### Prompt Caching Demo

```bash
# First request: creates cache (10K tokens written)
time claude message "Analyze consolidation" --cache

# Second request: hits cache (90% savings)
time claude message "Compare strategies" --cache
```

### Cost Comparison

```bash
# Compare three models on same task
claude benchmark "Explain quantum computing" \
  --models "claude-haiku-4-5,claude-sonnet-4-6,claude-opus-4-6" \
  --format csv > benchmark.csv

# Calculate costs
awk -F, '{input+=150; output+=$4} END {
  for (m in models) print m, cost[m]
}' benchmark.csv
```

### Batch Analysis

```bash
# Create batch input (JSONL)
cat > batch.jsonl << EOF
{"model": "claude-opus-4-6", "max_tokens": 1024, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is X?"}]}
{"model": "claude-opus-4-6", "max_tokens": 1024, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is Y?"}]}
EOF

# Submit
BATCH_ID=$(claude batch batch.jsonl | jq -r '.')

# Monitor (check every 30 seconds)
while true; do
  status=$(claude batch --status $BATCH_ID | jq '.processing_status')
  [ "$status" = "\"succeeded\"" ] && break
  sleep 30
done
```

## Architecture

```
src/
├── main.rs              # CLI entry point (clap subcommands)
├── client.rs            # HTTP client to Claude API (reqwest)
├── config.rs            # ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from env
├── error.rs             # Error types
├── models/
│   ├── anthropic.rs     # Claude request/response structures
│   ├── openai.rs        # OpenAI-compatible structures
│   └── mod.rs
├── server/
│   ├── mod.rs           # Server module
│   ├── routes.rs        # (unused, for future expansion)
│   └── transform.rs     # OpenAI ↔ Claude conversion
├── commands/
│   ├── serve.rs         # HTTP server (POST /v1/messages)
│   ├── message.rs       # Direct message API
│   ├── vision.rs        # Image analysis (WIP)
│   └── ...              # Other legacy commands
```

### Transform Pipeline

```
User Request (OpenAI format)
    ↓
server/transform::openai_to_claude()
    ↓
Claude API (via client.rs)
    ↓
server/transform::claude_to_openai()
    ↓
OpenAI-format Response
```

## Development Notes

### Known Limitations

- **Stub responses**: Server currently returns mock response, doesn't actually call Claude API yet
- **System prompts**: Partially implemented; extraction from OpenAI format incomplete
- **Tool calling**: Transform layer exists but not wired to OpenAI tool schema conversion
- **Streaming**: Not implemented
- **Error messages**: Generic API error responses (no detailed error mapping)

### Testing

No automated tests written yet. Manual testing required:

```bash
# Start server
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-..." ./target/release/claude serve --port 8000

# In another terminal
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/v1/messages \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "gpt-4o", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "test"}]}'
```

Expected: Returns mock response (currently)
Actual: Should return actual Claude API response (not yet implemented)

## Contributing

cargo clippy -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check

use thiserror::Error;

#[derive(Error, Debug)]
pub enum CliError {
    #[error("Configuration error: {0}")]
    Config(String),

    #[error("API error: {0}")]
    Api(String),

    #[error("Request failed: {0}")]
    Request(String),

    #[error("Invalid format: {0}")]
    Format(String),

    #[error("File error: {0}")]
    File(#[from] std::io::Error),

    #[error("JSON error: {0}")]
    Json(#[from] serde_json::Error),

    #[error("Rate limited: retry after {0} seconds")]
    RateLimited(u64),

    #[error("Model not found: {0}")]
    ModelNotFound(String),
}

impl From<reqwest::Error> for CliError {
    fn from(err: reqwest::Error) -> Self {
        CliError::Request(err.to_string())
    }
}
